notes.title: Summer For You - We are forced to postpone the release to January 31st 😭
notes.notes:
https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/41585176/a3b8e2310b43d7c2d94a3f3678bf3909d4ced230.jpg

Hello, we have to postpone the release of our game Summer For You to January 31st. The reason: our game is still on moderation process. Now our game is completely ready and we are only waiting for approval from Steam administration to allow us so that we can release the game 👈

With this decision comes a great sadness for us 😭😭😭 Unfortunately, we were not able to influence in any way to speed up the checkout of our game, although we wrote several times to Steam Support about it. We love everyone and promise that our game will get even better over the next week, which we will spend to create some more exclusives!

We hope you don't reject us and understand this situation 🙏🥺

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2066980/Summer_For_You

notes.title: Patch 5.5
notes.notes:
Patch 5.5 Released! Game release!

After a long time, the game is finally ready! We put a lot of effort and all our soul into the game, and we hope that you will like it!

After the release, the final patch 5.6 will be released, which will add the missing arts to the gallery!

Have a nice game everyone!

We are waiting for patch 5.5!

-
Mini-games with special arts will be added to all chapters

If you have already purchased the game,
please write a review for it! This helps in promoting the game and we get feedback that helps us improve the game!
